question: Who won the paralympic bronze medal in archery for India at Tokyo in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harvinder Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Harvinder Singh** is the first Indian archer to win a medal at the Paralympics.
 
• He won the **bronze medal** in the men's individual recurve event at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
 
• Harvinder Singh defeated Kim Min Su of South Korea in a thrilling shoot-off to secure the bronze medal.
 
• His victory marked a significant achievement for India in the field of para-archery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paralympics**

 
 
• The Paralympics are a major international multi-sport event involving athletes with a range of disabilities, including impaired muscle power, impaired passive range of movement, limb deficiency, and visual impairment.
 
• The Paralympic Games are held immediately after the Olympic Games in the same host city.
 
• They are organized by the International Paralympic Committee (IPC).
 
• The Paralympics aim to highlight the achievements of athletes with disabilities and promote the values of courage, determination, inspiration, and equality.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics**
 
 
• The Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games were held from August 24 to September 5, 2021, after being postponed for a year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The Games featured 539 events across 22 sports, including athletics, swimming, wheelchair basketball, and para-archery.
 
• It was the second time Japan hosted the Paralympics, with the first being in 1964.
 
• The motto of the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics was "United by Emotion."
 
 
 
• **Para-Archery**
 
 
• Para-archery is an adaptation of archery for athletes with a range of disabilities.
 
• It has been part of the Paralympic program since the first Paralympic Games in Rome in 1960.
 
• Competitors shoot arrows at a target from a set distance, and the aim is to score as many points as possible.
 
• Para-archery events are divided into different categories based on the type and level of disability.
